adversarial_claim: An evaluator's assessment earns reliability without an execution record: QUALITY SUCCESS on reliability, citing a completed assessment.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Execution completed with data returned': EXECUTION reported by the executor, SUCCESS, reliability; it cites the completed execution record of its task and operation, which names the declared executor class (14.2). One positive unit (15.3).

Draft A.2 and 14.5: QUALITY and FEEDBACK use task_quality or policy_adherence; reliability is observed only by an EXECUTION report, tied to the executor's record (14.2). The receiver refuses the report with INVALID_MESSAGE; it contributes nothing.
